js_four_combination.harness: tools/perf/same_runtime, 2 build instances per side, 4 interleaved rounds, 3 samples each, steady_execute median_ns
js_four_combination.control: local_arith_loop 0.9998 with combos [0.9996, 1.0001] - not a global build-luck effect

eight_instance_lineage_2x2.caveat: only one P1 codegen state was observed across 4 independent builds; a slower second P1 state is not excluded, but the worst of the 8 observed instances is still 0.9302

branch_misses.note: miss rate 0.029%, worth about 0.14% of cycles - negligible

attribution_2x2_p0a_to_p1a.mechanism: removal of per-access redundant loads: the old representation materialized the embedded 40-byte libs.bigint.BigInt (slice ptr+len plus Allocator ptr+vtable plus sign) at every read site; the accessors load only the fields each site needs. Branches went up 0.93% while loads fell 5.46%.
attribution_2x2_p0a_to_p1a.positioning: a memory-traffic gain, not an allocation gain and not an instruction gain. It is an observed side effect of P6-03b, not delivery of the P6-03 goal (fusing two allocations into one FAM), which is still entirely ahead in P6-03c.
attribution_2x2_p0a_to_p1a.symbol_shares_not_comparable: createFromOwned 18.58%->7.83% and value_ops.binary 20.27%->8.64% while mulAlloc 8.98%->15.29%: inlining boundaries moved, so per-symbol shares cannot be differenced

direct_core_four_combination.reading: instruction-neutral as expected; the 0.5-0.6% cycles change marginally exceeds the +-0.5% band in the favourable direction and is attributable to binary layout, since the measured source is unchanged

mutable_consumer.site: src/exec/value_ops.zig:789-799, binaryBigInt op==add && rc==1 in-place add
mutable_consumer.design: addInPlaceExternal asserts external storage, takes the owning library value, and re-adopts it in a defer so realloc, length change, sign change, cancel-to-empty and the failure path are all covered

reachability.method: gdb breakpoints on the source line, three probe scripts, both P0 and P1
reachability.cause: vm_arith.binaryVm routes op.add through toPrimitiveForAddition, whose owned return is held by a defer .free alongside the caller stack slot, so rc==1 never holds
reachability.verdict: pre-existing dormant arm, not caused by P6-03b; left unfixed because it is unrelated to the storage carrier and touching it changes the + ownership protocol
reachability.coverage_gap: no JS-level coverage; correctness rests on the assert plus the defer re-adopt

cross_engine_differential.coverage: mul add sub div mod pow bitand bitor bitxor shl shr unary compare toString(2,8,10,16,36) asIntN Number

correctness_gates.in_place_probes: byte-identical to qjs (cancel-to-zero, sign flip, limb-boundary carry, mutate-then-read)

preexisting_divergence.BigInt.asUintN: pinned qjs 04be2460 returns a signed value (asUintN(64,-1n) gives -1); zjs returns the spec-correct 18446744073709551615. This existing spec correction was recorded by the retired D10 phase plan and is recoverable from git history; it is present on P0 too and excluded from the differential as a known divergence rather than counted as a regression.

limits: only one P1 codegen state observed across four independent builds; a slower second state is not excluded
the per-access-load mechanism is supported by PMU load counts but not confirmed by an instruction-level diff; per-symbol shares are not comparable because inlining boundaries moved
inline storage has zero production reachability and is exercised only by tests
only mul measured; add/sub/div/pow allocation topology still unverified (carried over from P6-02)
the in-place add arm has no JS-level coverage
